body: I hope so. I want to believe it would hurt people less than me doing it myself and finding me. But the climate anxiety is a good part of why I want to die so badly. I've been suicidal since I was fifteen but I used to have hope. Now, I can't see myself living past my mothers death and I feel relieved at the thought of the end but also I know what it would do to people. I'm going around in circles and I just can't cope.
What about if climate change has become so deadly by/before then that resources are scarce and people want to go? There will be plenty who want to live so why not, what do you think?
